hide.description: The condition to hide the element

allowedGroups.description: The groups that can see the element

order.description:
The order of the element. We recommend to use 10, 20, etc for base elements and 100, 200, etc
for package specific elements. The dynamic component will render the elements in ascending order

title:
Represent an element that is conditionally renderable through {@link GenAiUiDynamicBaseElementsRenderer}
It can be hidden through a condition, and can be restricted to a set of user groups
name: GenAiUiConditionallyRenderableElement
